user.title: Create Notification Pool
user.description: A notification pool targets a set of lights and switches for LED notifications. Give your pool a name and select the devices or entities to include.

init.description: This pool targets a set of lights for LED notifications. Configure the target devices and manage notifications below.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Choose which devices and entities this pool targets for notifications.

add.title: Add Notification
add.description: Define a new LED notification. Duration 0 = stateful (switch), duration > 0 = momentary (button).

error.name_exists: A notification with this name already exists.
